svg.title: Docker Sandbox: your agent's commands run in a local container
svg.desc: The model calls Coder, Shell or FileSystem tools such as run_command and edit_file. DockerSandbox's get_workspace hook gives the run a Docker container on your machine as ctx.workspace, and each command and file operation runs in it through docker exec; output comes back to the tool. The first use creates the container with docker run and the ai.pydantic.workspace=true label, its WorkspaceRef holds the container name, a later run reattaches with it, and destroy(ref) removes it. A project directory mounted with docker_args is the only part of your files the commands can change. A container shares your kernel, a weaker boundary than a VM.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
